docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Kale’s edition of Kālidāsa’s epic poem of the Solar dynasty, with Mallinātha’s commentary, a literal English translation and notes, in the Sanskrit text (Bombay, 1922). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Robarts Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The Raghuvamsa of Kalidasa : with the commentary (the Samjivani) of Mallinatha ; Cantos I-X ; edited with a literal English translation, copious notes in Sanskrit and English, and various readings &c. &c. by M.R. Kale · Klidsa, Mallinatha. Sajvan, Kle, M. R. (Moreshvar Ramchandra) · 1922, 658 scanned pages. Published 1922; Moreshwar Ramchandra Kale died 1930; the poem is classical and Mallinātha’s commentary medieval; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The pages are shown as scans in this library's viewer (zoom, pan, thumbnails); the text of this book is in a script the machine reading of the scans cannot yet give.
